Vietlook Travel shares with you things to know when visiting Da Nang – Hoi An, please refer to have the most perfect and enjoyable trip, in addition to the famous landscapes in Da Nang, visitors can also immerse themselves in the clear blue water of the sea and islands and participate in exciting games on the sea.

1. When is the best time to travel to Da Nang – Hoi An?

The ideal time to travel to Hoi An is the first 3 months of the year or during the Lunar New Year. This is a beautiful time with cool climate and light sunshine. If you want to immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere, you should travel to Hoi An during Tet.

If you are a person who loves to watch and swim in the sea or enjoy vibrant sea festivals, travel to Da Nang in the summer starting from April and lasting until the end of July every year, because in autumn the sea often has big storms and waves, not suitable for you to go to the beach, in winter the weather is quite cold, suitable for resort tours Da Nang.

Therefore, if you want to immerse yourself in the colors of spring, travel to Da Nang – Hoi An in the spring to join in the joyful spring atmosphere, with flowers blooming in spring, especially the tulip festival on top of Ba Na taking place in a vibrant atmosphere.

2. How to travel between Da Nang and Hoi An

Da Nang and Hoi An are not far from each other, so you can travel between the two places by different means of transport such as:

Motorbike: For a day trip to Hoi An from Da Nang, you can cross the Han River Bridge and then follow the Da Nang-Hoi An provincial road, about 30km long. Or you can go south on National Highway 1 and turn left onto Vinh Dien Street, then turn onto Huynh Thuc Khang Street to reach Hoi An, about 40km long.

Bus: There is a bus service between Da Nang and Hoi An. You can catch bus number 01 at Da Nang or Hoi An bus station and travel between the two places. The travel time may be longer, however, this public transport is not convenient for tourists to visit by motorbike or taxi.

Taxi: is a convenient means of transportation for tourists to visit, the driver will show you the way, and the fare between Da Nang and Hoi An is not too expensive.

3. Where to stay when traveling to Da Nang – Hoi An?

This question has become very familiar when you plan your trip. Da Nang is a center of strong tourism development in terms of hotel services, motels or high-end resorts. However, how to choose a hotel depends on your budget.

In Da Nang – Hoi An, if your budget is comfortable, you can choose 4-5 star hotels, and the rooms all have beautiful views of the beach or the city, such as Pullman Danang Beach Resort and Fusion Maia Danang, which will definitely bring great experiences to visitors.

In Hoi An, there are many different types of accommodation, including guesthouses, motels, mid-range hotels and luxury resorts. If you are looking for a more economical experience, you can choose a guesthouse or mid-range hotel, but if you are ready for the budget, choosing 4 or 5 star hotels and resorts is the right choice.

So when you go to Hoi An or Da Nang, there are different prices for you to choose from. You should choose hotels near My Khe beach or Han River bridge for convenient sightseeing.

4. Must-see tourist attractions in Hoi An – Da Nang

Coming to Da Nang – Hoi An, which offers countless breathtaking sceneries, and when you choose two destinations for your vacation, it will definitely bring you the most enjoyable vacation, and the attractions you should know are

Son Tra Peninsula

A place likened to a precious gem in the heart of the city. In addition to the vibrant, diverse and poetic landscape, Son Tra is also a spiritual tourist destination with attractive landmarks.

The first stop on your Son Tra journey is Ban Co Peak. To reach Ba Co Peak, you have to cross a winding and winding trail that winds along the coast, through primeval forests and offers stunning views of the mountain ranges. From Ban Co Peak, you will feel like you have entered a fairyland with a poetic landscape and a giant statue that looks like King Kong sitting.

My Khe Beach

One of the most beautiful beaches on the planet, with clear blue water and long stretches of sand, is the most beautiful place to hide from the sun every summer. In addition, visitors can experience surfing, rowing or jet skiing. Especially watching the sunset or sunrise creates a beautiful picture.

Monkey Island in Da Nang

Son Tra Peninsula, also known as Monkey Mountain, is home to many rare and endangered species of plants and animals, such as the red-shanked douc langur – the queen of primates, golden monkeys, pythons, red-faced chickens, etc.

On the top of Son Tra Mountain, there is a large stone statue of a monkey as a symbol of the habitat of these primates. In addition, visitors can enjoy a panoramic view of Da Nang beach from a height of more than 500m at the DRT Radio Station. Explore the US military radar station built in the 1960s, nicknamed “The Eye of the East Sea”.

Trek through the forest to the helipad and explore the lush tropical flora and fauna. And especially, observe the playful douc langurs on the nearly one-thousand-year-old fig tree.

Mui Nghe Son Tra

Located in the southeast of Son Tra peninsula, Mui Nghe or Hon Nghe, when the first rays of sunlight shine on Mui Nghe looks like a rock jutting out into the sea, like a majestic lion lying on the water surface.

From Mui Nghe Son Tra, visitors can see the clear blue sea and is home to groupers and snappers. Visitors can drop their fishing rods to catch fish, and the products are brought back to be processed and enjoyed right away, there is nothing more interesting.

If visiting Da Nang – Hoi An, in addition to admiring the sights, visitors can also visit Mui Nghe to experience scuba diving to explore the sparkling and fascinating coral reefs.

Ly Son Island

A destination that many tourists visit every summer, this place not only attracts visitors with its famous landscapes, or the green garlic fields, but when coming to Ly Son Island, visitors also encounter luxurious resorts with beautiful sea views.

Ly Son consists of three islands: Big Island, Small Island and Mu Cu Island, symbolizing the harmonious connection between people and nature. When coming to Ly Son, you can rent a tent, to enjoy the scenery, immerse yourself in nature and enjoy local specialties such as: Cassava leaf cake, clam shells, king crab and Ly Son garlic salad…

In addition, if you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang – Ly Son Island, visit famous landscapes such as: To Vo Gate, Hang Pagoda, Cau Cave and Thoi Loi Peak… will bring you the most unforgettable experience, especially in the summer when the weather is hot and clear, without storms, it is the ideal time for you to visit or camp by the sea.

Cu Lao Cham

A place known as a green pearl in the middle of the ocean. With a cool climate all year round and lush greenery covering the island, Cu Lao Cham is recognized by UNESCO as a biosphere reserve and a tourist paradise for travelers.

Cu Lao Cham Ecological Reserve is home to many species of fish, marine life, colorful coral reefs, seaweed, seagrass and rare flora and fauna.

Besides its rich and diverse nature, Cu Lao Cham is also known as a place with many cultural and religious relics of the Cham people that have survived to this day. Besides, there are also ancient architectural works dating back hundreds of years.

Da Nang Pearl Island

Also known as Hon Son Tra Con, Hon Son Cha, Cu Lao Han, Dao Ngoc, Hon Cho, Hon Chao Island. The island is very close to the marina on the Han River, from afar the island rises up like a pan. Coming here, you can light a campfire together and participate in water sports such as: Surfing, paragliding, kayaking or fishing … will bring visitors the most perfect vacation, especially foreign tourists when traveling to Da Nang – Hoi An often visit Hon Chao Island to admire the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.

5. What to eat when traveling Da Nang – Hoi An?

Da Nang – Hoi An not only welcomes tourists with famous landmarks, but this place also brings visitors delicious and attractive dishes, including dishes such as:

Quang noodles: A famous dish in Quang land, any tourist when traveling to Da Nang enjoys Quang noodles to feel the delicious flavor of the Central cuisine that brings to visitors.

Types of sweet soup: One of the light dishes but chosen by many diners, especially young people, when the weather in the Central region is in the summer, you can enjoy a cup of sweet soup, watch the scenery, enjoy the cool breeze blowing from the sea, there is nothing more interesting.

Seafood: Da Nang Hoi An is known for its many fresh seafood, Da Nang seafood is bought by people on the boat when the boat just docks, so you must try it when you have the opportunity to set foot here.

Banh Can, Banh Xeo: Although the cakes are light, they will bring diners a very unique flavor, because the cakes here have a very unique flavor, aroma and crispiness.

Cao Lau: This noodle dish looks quite similar to Quang noodles, but the noodles are handmade from rice flour and tree ash. This dish is served with a thick broth made from pork skin, fresh vegetables, shrimp, and meat, creating a delicious, unique flavor of Central cuisine.
